destinationDetails.faq1.question: What is an eSIM?
destinationDetails.faq1.answer: An eSIM is a built-in digital SIM that lets you activate a mobile data plan without a physical card. Just choose a plan, scan a QR code, and connect instantly when you travel.
destinationDetails.faq2.question: How do I install an eSIM?
destinationDetails.faq2.answer: After purchase, you'll receive a QR code via email. Simply go to your phone's settings, select 'Add eSIM' or 'Add Cellular Plan', and scan the QR code. The eSIM will be installed in seconds.
destinationDetails.faq3.question: Do I need a compatible device?
destinationDetails.faq3.answer: Yes, your device must be eSIM compatible. Most newer iPhones (XS and later), Google Pixels (3 and later), and Samsung Galaxy devices (S20 and later) support eSIM. You can check your device compatibility on our website.
destinationDetails.faq4.question: Can I use data, calls, and SMS?
destinationDetails.faq4.answer: Most of our plans include data only. However, some regions offer plans with calls and SMS. Check the plan details to see what's included.
destinationDetails.faq5.question: Will my physical SIM card stop working?
destinationDetails.faq5.answer: No, your physical SIM card will continue to work normally. You can keep it in your phone and switch between your local SIM and eSIM whenever you want.

FAQSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about eSIM Connect
FAQSection.faq1Answer: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM that allows you to activate a cellular plan without using a physical SIM card. It's built into your device and can be programmed with different carrier profiles, making it perfect for travelers.
FAQSection.faq2Question: How do I install an eSIM?
FAQSection.faq2Answer: After purchase, you'll receive a QR code via email. Simply go to your phone's settings, select 'Add eSIM' or 'Add Cellular Plan', and scan the QR code. The eSIM will be installed in seconds.
FAQSection.faq3Question: Is my device compatible with eSIM?
FAQSection.faq3Answer: Most modern smartphones support eSIM, including iPhone XS and newer, Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer, Google Pixel 3 and newer, and many other devices. Check our compatibility page for a full list.
FAQSection.faq4Question: Can I keep my WhatsApp number?
FAQSection.faq4Answer: Yes! The eSIM provides data connectivity only. Your original phone number and WhatsApp will continue to work as before. You can use both SIMs simultaneously.
FAQSection.faq5Question: When does my data plan start?
FAQSection.faq5Answer: Your data plan activates when you first connect to a mobile network in your destination country. You can install the eSIM before you travel, and it will start working when you arrive.
FAQSection.faq6Question: What happens if I run out of data?
FAQSection.faq6Answer: You can easily top up your data through our app or website. Additional data packages are available for purchase at any time, and they're added to your existing eSIM instantly.
